hints.title: Chain Predecessor Sequence Lengths
hints.text: For each number x, an arithmetic sequence ending at x must extend a sequence ending at x minus difference.

hints.title: Map Ending Value to Longest Length
hints.text: Store the length of the longest subsequence ending at value x, updating it as length at (x - difference) plus one.

hints.title: Track Global Maximum
hints.text: Update the global maximum after processing each element in the input array.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs or subsequences incurs quadratic or exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining maximum chain length per ending value yields linear time and linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only the immediately preceding arithmetic term determines the optimal chain.
complexity.notes: Difference can be negative, zero, or positive.
